title: Effectiveness, Opposition and the Second New Deal
reason: The only legacy claim present is conflating Dorothea Lange's FSA photography and post-office murals with the WPA's Federal Project Number One, which is a minor detail of administration that would not cost marks on an AQA GCSE history exam.
